SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MEMBER M.A.C.T-XII AT VIJAYAPUR, IN MVC NO.1680/2012 BY ALLOWING THE APPEAL AS PRAYED FOR IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THESE APPEALS COMING ON FOR FINAL DISPOSAL,
THIS DAY, B.M. SHYAM PRASAD J., DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

These appeals are filed calling in question the judgment and award dated 20.03.2020 insofar as the claim petition in MVC No.1680/2012 on the file of the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT-XII, Vijayapur NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB (for short, 'the Tribunal').
The impugned judgment and award dated 20.03.2020 is common to the claim petitions in MVC No.1680/2012 and MVC No.525/2013.

The claim petition in MVC No.1680/2012 is allowed granting compensation in a sum of Rs.24,49,200/- with interest at the rate of 6%, and the other claim petition in MVC No.525/2013 is allowed granting compensation of Rs.2,36,800/- with interest at the rate of 6%.
The accident is involving two motorcycles, but the liability to pay the aforesaid compensations is fastened only on the Insurer of one of the motorcycles.
2. The appeal in MFA No.200505/2021 is by the Insurer of one of the aforesaid motor cycles and the appeal in MFA No.201664/2021 is by the claimants in MVC No.1680/2012.
The parties are referred to as claimants and Insurer in these proceedings.

The question for consideration in these appeals is whether the Tribunal has rightly appreciated the material on record and arrived at a just decision on the cause for accident involving motorcycles bearing Reg. No. KA- NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB 28/Y-2246 and KA-28/R-9810, and if the Tribunal's finding in this regard cannot be sustained, what order should be made.
3.

The claimants are the wife, parents and six children of the deceased Sri Dhanasing who was traveling on the pillion of the motorcycle bearing Reg. No. KA-28/Y-2246, and Sri Shiva Lal, (the claimant in MVC No.525/2013) was riding the motorcycle.
The accident is when there is collusion between this motorcycle and the motorcycle bearing Reg. No. KA- 28/R-9810.
The owner of this motorcycle bearing Reg. No. KA-28/R-9810 is impleaded as a respondent but because it was not insured as of the date of the accident.

4. The claimants' petition in MVC No.1680/2012 is under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 and the claim petition by Sri Shiva Lal in MVC No.525/2013 is under Section 163A of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

The Tribunal has framed the NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB following two issues as the first issues in both the claim petitions:
1. Whether the petitioners prove that Dhanasing S/o Limbaji Rathod died in the Daneshwari Urf Danubai And Ors vs Prakash And Ors on 15 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50611901/

sentences.text: Motor Vehicle Accident that occurred on 26.09.2012 at about 7-00 p.m. Tikota to Somadevarhatti road, Near Jodgudda, Tikota, Tq. Dist: Vijaypur on account of rash and negligent driving of Motorcycle bearing No.KA-28/Y-2246 by its driver as alleged.

2. Whether the petitioners prove that, on 26.09.2013 while he was travelling on Motorcycle bearing No.KA-28/Y-2246 from Somadevarhatti to Tikota, near Jodaguddad of Tikota, the rider of Motorcycle No.KA- 28/R-9810 came in rash and negligent manner and dashed to him, as a result he sustained multiple injuries.
5. The Tribunal has observed that the issues are not properly framed, and it could be corrected but has not cast fresh issues.

Further, the Tribunal has observed that charge sheet is filed against the riders of both the motorcycles, and the Tribunal has opined that - 10 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB both the riders were negligent.

However, the final opinion is inconclusive, and the finding in this regard reads as under:
"The cross-examination of Rw1 is total denial.

It is a specific defence that the petitioner in MVC No.525/2013 has borrowed the motorcycle bearing No.28/Y-2246 for his personal work, the petitioner would step into the shoes of the owner of motor cycle, thereby the petition in MVC No.525/2013 is not maintainable.

Considering the material placed on record so also the case put forth by the petitioners, I am of the considered view that, the petitioners have proved these cases on the touch stone of preponderance of probabilities.
Hence, I answer issue No.1 in the Affirmative."

6. The Tribunal ultimately has found the Insurer of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/Y-2246 liable on the ground that though it is contended that Sri Shivalal and the claimants herein have produced fake certificate as Ex.P-20, the official of the concerned RTO had stated in his evidence that the license produced by the aforesaid looks like a genuine one, and therefore, the Insurer of the motorcycle bearing - 11 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB Reg.No.KA-28/Y-2246 cannot avoid liability.

This Court must, at this stage, opine that neither the Tribunal's conclusion on the reason for the accident nor the conclusion on the genuineness of the license inspires confidence and the aforesaid questions will have to be reconsidered and such reconsideration must be by the Tribunal after due opportunity.
7.
The owner of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810 is served in the appeal filed by the claimants through paper publication and in the regular mode in the appeal filed by the Insurer.

sentences.text: Presently, Sri Basavaraj R. Math is on vakalath for this owner, but he has issued notice of retirement for want of instructions.

If the claimants and the other respondents can appear on the first date of hearing as fixed by this order, there will have to be fresh notice to the owner of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810 by the Tribunal before there can be final reconsideration on remand pursuant to this order.

Hence, the following:
- 12 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB ORDER (i) The appeal by the Insurer in MFA No.200505/2021 is allowed quashing the Tribunal's judgment insofar as the conclusion in MVC No.1680/2012 on the reason for the accident and the liability of the Insurer.

(ii) The appeal in MFA No.201664/2021 stands disposed of in the light of the aforesaid order leaving open all questions for the claimants to seek variance in the compensation now computed by the Tribunal.

(iii) The claimants and the other respondents - the owner and Insurer of the motorcycle bearing Reg. No.KA-28/Y-2246 - shall appear without further notice before the Tribunal on 17.07.2023, and insofar as the owner of the other motorcycle bearing - 13 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810, the Tribunal shall issue fresh process.
(iv) The Tribunal shall endeavor to complete the final adjudication on remand within a period of six months from the date of this judgment.
 (v) The Registry shall take steps to see that the  trial Court records are returned  expeditiously.
 (vi) The amount in deposit shall also stand transferred to the Tribunal for necessary orders after final adjudication.

The Tribunal ultimately has found the Insurer of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/Y-2246 liable on the ground that though it is contended that Sri Shivalal and the claimants herein have produced fake certificate as Ex.P-20, the official of the concerned RTO had stated in his evidence that the license produced by the aforesaid looks like a genuine one, and therefore, the Insurer of the motorcycle bearing - 11 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB Reg.No.KA-28/Y-2246 cannot avoid liability.
The owner of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810 is served in the appeal filed by the claimants through paper publication and in the regular mode in the appeal filed by the Insurer.
opennyai_summary.decision:
This Court must, at this stage, opine that neither the Tribunal's conclusion on the reason for the accident nor the conclusion on the genuineness of the license inspires confidence and the aforesaid questions will have to be reconsidered and such reconsideration must be by the Tribunal after due opportunity.
7.
If the claimants and the other respondents can appear on the first date of hearing as fixed by this order, there will have to be fresh notice to the owner of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810 by the Tribunal before there can be final reconsideration on remand pursuant to this order.
Hence, the following:
- 12 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB ORDER (i) The appeal by the Insurer in MFA No.200505/2021 is allowed quashing the Tribunal's judgment insofar as the conclusion in MVC No.1680/2012 on the reason for the accident and the liability of the Insurer.
(ii) The appeal in MFA No.201664/2021 stands disposed of in the light of the aforesaid order leaving open all questions for the claimants to seek variance in the compensation now computed by the Tribunal.
(iii) The claimants and the other respondents - the owner and Insurer of the motorcycle bearing Reg. No.KA-28/Y-2246 - shall appear without further notice before the Tribunal on 17.07.2023, and insofar as the owner of the other motorcycle bearing - 13 - NC: 2023:KHC-K:1121-DB Reg.No.KA-28/R-9810, the Tribunal shall issue fresh process.
(iv) The Tribunal shall endeavor to complete the final adjudication on remand within a period of six months from the date of this judgment.
 (v) The Registry shall take steps to see that the  trial Court records are returned  expeditiously.
 (vi) The amount in deposit shall also stand transferred to the Tribunal for necessary orders after final adjudication.
